verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Muse has its own computer with a file system and terminal, so it writes its own code and builds the tools a task needs (muse-docs-1, muse-docs-7). It builds data artifacts such as a spending tracker or a sleep-pattern dashboard (muse-docs-16), and everything it generates in the VM can be inspected and downloaded (muse-supp-vm-files-export). missing for 10: explicit documentation of chart or plot generation and of code-computed answers on uploaded data (dashboards only imply this), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of code execution on user data.
